headline: US Fed held its rate at 3.75 to 4.00%
detail: Two members voted for a hike.

headline: Democrats won control of the US House and were set to take the Senate in the midterm elections
detail: Time is the first report found (Variety, about 03:23 UTC, 8:53 am IST); by 4 Nov they had also taken the Senate, gaining five seats.

headline: US stocks sold off sharply from the open, led by AI and chip stocks: Nasdaq about -5% during the day
detail: By 1 pm New York time (18:00 UTC): Nasdaq -5.3%, S&P 500 -4.0%, Dow -3.1%, the chip index -11%; Nvidia -7%, AMD -13%, Micron -13%, Tesla and SpaceX -9%; VIX up 55% to about 26; Bitcoin below $76,000; Brent back near $97. Reports tie it to worries that the new Democratic Congress could limit data-centre building and raise its power and water costs, with no specific proposal named. These are intraday figures, not the close; the close goes in a later row.
